risks.risk: Engine or gearbox may not be from a Lexus 460
risks.proof: Photo showing the engine or gearbox with visible branding or model tag, or a VIN plate or engine code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used engine and gearbox, not Lexus 460

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the engine running, or close-up of internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to check for wear or damage.

risks.risk: Gearbox may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the gearbox in operation, or close-up of internal gears and clutch mechanism.

risks.risk: Engine and gearbox may not be matched (e.g., engine not compatible with gearbox)
risks.proof: Photo showing the engine and gearbox together, or a photo of the engine code and gearbox model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mismatched or unknown compatibility

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Photo of the engine or gearbox with visible branding or model tag.
Video or photo showing the engine running.
Photo showing the engine and gearbox together, or close-up of engine and gearbox model numbers.
Photo of the VIN plate or vehicle registration if available.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
